description.en: The church clock on the green: Mrs Hartley teaching the time (quarter past, noon, a minute late or early, on time), Auntie Edna counting the strokes when it strikes, a bit deaf, Mr Dixon winding it, and Old Wilf's days of the sundial.
description.sl: Cerkvena ura na zelenici: gospa Hartley uči, koliko je ura (četrt na, poldne, minuta prepozno ali prezgodaj, pravočasno), teta Edna, ki šteje udarce, ko ura bije, malo naglušna, gospod Dixon, ki jo navija, in časi starega Wilfa s sončno uro.
description.it: L'orologio della chiesa sul prato: la signora Hartley insegna l'ora (e un quarto, mezzogiorno, un minuto in ritardo o in anticipo, in orario), zia Edna che conta i rintocchi, un po' sorda, il signor Dixon che lo carica, e i tempi del vecchio Wilf, con la meridiana.
description.de: Die Kirchturmuhr auf der Dorfwiese: Mrs Hartley bringt die Uhrzeit bei (Viertel nach, Mittag, eine Minute zu spät oder zu früh, pünktlich), Tante Edna, die beim Schlagen die Schläge zählt, ein bisschen schwerhörig, Herr Dixon, der sie aufzieht, und die Zeiten des alten Wilf mit der Sonnenuhr.

words.example_it: Sono le quattro e un quarto.
words.note: Fifteen minutes after the hour: quarter past four is 4:15. Before the hour: quarter to.
words.note_sl: Petnajst minut čez polno uro: quarter past four je 4.15, četrt na pet (Angleži štejejo od ure, ki je minila). Pred uro: quarter to.
words.note_it: Quindici minuti dopo l'ora: quarter past four sono le 4.15. Prima dell'ora: quarter to.
words.note_de: Fünfzehn Minuten nach der vollen Stunde: quarter past four ist 4.15. Vor der Stunde: quarter to.

words.note: Strike, struck, struck. The clock struck three: its bell rang three times.
words.note_sl: Strike, struck, struck. The clock struck three: ura je odbila tri, zvon je zazvonil trikrat.
words.note_it: Strike, struck, struck. The clock struck three: l'orologio ha battuto le tre, la campana ha suonato tre volte.
words.note_de: Strike, struck, struck. The clock struck three: die Uhr hat drei geschlagen, die Glocke hat dreimal geläutet.

words.example_de: Beeil dich, du bist spät dran!
words.note: Be late: come after the time. Sorry I'm late! (with be).
words.note_sl: Be late: priti po dogovorjenem času. Sorry I'm late! (z be: oprosti, da zamujam).
words.note_it: Be late: arrivare dopo l'ora giusta. Sorry I'm late! (con be: scusa il ritardo).
words.note_de: Be late: nach der Zeit kommen. Sorry I'm late! (mit be: Entschuldigung, dass ich zu spät bin).

words.example_it: La signora Hartley arriva sempre presto.
words.note: Early is before the time, late after it. The early bird catches the worm!
words.note_sl: Early je pred časom, late po njem. The early bird catches the worm: rana ura, zlata ura!
words.note_it: Early è prima dell'ora, late dopo. The early bird catches the worm: il mattino ha l'oro in bocca!
words.note_de: Early ist vor der Zeit, late danach. The early bird catches the worm: Morgenstund hat Gold im Mund!

words.note: On time: not early, not late, just right. In time: not too late, in time for tea.
words.note_sl: On time: ne prezgodaj ne prepozno, točno. In time: še pravi čas, in time for tea.
words.note_it: On time: né presto né tardi, puntuale. In time: in tempo, in time for tea.
words.note_de: On time: nicht zu früh, nicht zu spät, pünktlich. In time: rechtzeitig, in time for tea.

words.note: Sixty minutes in an hour. Just a minute! means wait a little.
words.note_sl: Ura ima šestdeset minut. Just a minute! pomeni: samo malo počakaj.
words.note_it: Un'ora ha sessanta minuti. Just a minute! vuol dire: aspetta un attimo.
words.note_de: Eine Stunde hat sechzig Minuten. Just a minute! heißt: einen Moment.

words.example_en: At noon the bell rings twelve times.
words.example_it: A mezzogiorno la campana suona dodici volte.
words.example_de: Am Mittag läutet die Glocke zwölfmal.
words.note: Noon is twelve o'clock in the day, midnight twelve at night. At noon, at midnight: with at.
words.note_sl: Noon je dvanajst podnevi, midnight dvanajst ponoči. At noon, at midnight: z at.
words.note_it: Noon sono le dodici di giorno, midnight le dodici di notte. At noon, at midnight: con at.
words.note_de: Noon ist zwölf Uhr am Tag, midnight zwölf Uhr nachts. At noon, at midnight: mit at.

words.example_en: The old church has a sundial.
words.example_it: La vecchia chiesa ha una meridiana.
words.example_de: Die alte Kirche hat eine Sonnenuhr.
words.note: A sundial tells the time with a shadow. Old churches had small ones scratched on the south wall.
words.note_sl: Sončna ura kaže čas s senco. Stare cerkve so imele majhne, vpraskane v južno steno.
words.note_it: La meridiana segna l'ora con un'ombra. Le vecchie chiese ne avevano di piccole, graffiate sul muro a sud.
words.note_de: Eine Sonnenuhr zeigt die Zeit mit einem Schatten. Alte Kirchen hatten kleine, in die Südwand geritzt.

words.example_it: Il nonno è un po' sordo.
words.note: A bit deaf, hard of hearing: you don't hear well. Speak up! means speak louder.
words.note_sl: A bit deaf, hard of hearing: slabo slišiš. Speak up! pomeni: govori glasneje.
words.note_it: A bit deaf, hard of hearing: non senti bene. Speak up! vuol dire: parla più forte.
words.note_de: A bit deaf, hard of hearing: man hört nicht gut. Speak up! heißt: sprich lauter.

words.example_en: The numbers on the clock are gold.
words.example_de: Die Zahlen auf der Uhr sind golden.
words.note: On old clocks the numbers are Roman: I, II, III … XII.
words.note_sl: Na starih urah so številke rimske: I, II, III … XII.
words.note_it: Sugli orologi antichi i numeri sono romani: I, II, III … XII.
words.note_de: Auf alten Uhren sind die Zahlen römisch: I, II, III … XII.

words.example_en: Mr Dixon winds the clock every week.
words.example_sl: Gospod Dixon vsak teden navije uro.
words.example_it: Il signor Dixon carica l'orologio ogni settimana.
words.example_de: Herr Dixon zieht die Uhr jede Woche auf.
words.note: To wind rhymes with find: wind, wound, wound. The wind that blows rhymes with tinned.
words.note_sl: To wind se rima s find: wind, wound, wound. Wind, ki piha (veter), pa se rima s tinned.
words.note_it: To wind fa rima con find: wind, wound, wound. Il wind che soffia (il vento) fa rima con tinned.
words.note_de: To wind reimt sich auf find: wind, wound, wound. Der wind, der weht (der Wind), reimt sich auf tinned.
